name: Paragraphs
summary: Use GOV.UK body classes for readable text, with lead and small variants only when their hierarchy has a clear purpose.
rules: Use govuk-body for the majority of paragraph text; its default desktop size is 19px.
Use govuk-body-l once at most near the start of a page when an introductory summary helps users.
Use govuk-body-s sparingly for genuinely secondary content, not to make crowded content fit.
Keep paragraphs concise and group related sentences under descriptive headings.
accessibility: Use p elements for paragraphs so content retains structure without CSS.
Do not convey importance only by size; use clear wording and semantic structure.
Maintain readable line lengths and test body text at enlarged sizes.
restrictions: Do not use the lead class for multiple paragraphs on the same page.
Do not make the majority of service content small body text.
